title: enroll response
description: Response of POST /hub/v1/enroll (PLAN.md S20). state enrolled carries the credential, which the hub shows exactly once and stores only as a hash. state pending (the token requires approval) carries retry_after, the number of seconds after which the agent repeats the request; the credential is returned by the first repetition after an administrator accepted the agent. Failures use HTTP status codes with the body {error: {code, message}}.
